thread:
Sophie: Hey team — 34 weeks today! 🎉 Planning a low-key surprise send-off lunch next Thursday 12:30pm in the kitchen. No big speeches, just sandwiches, cake, and a tiny present if folks want to chip in. Please don’t post about this in public channels (shh 🤫).
Amir: OMG congrats Sophie!! :tada: I can bring wraps + fruit.
Jin: So happy for you!! I’ll bring a vegan entrée. Any allergies/diet tags we should watch for?
Sophie: Thanks!! No major allergies, but one coworker is gluten-free. Also trying to keep it gender-neutral for the note/gift.
Liz: :cake: cake sounds perfect. I can pick one up if someone covers.
Katie: I’ll organize the card and a small photo book — can folks DM me a quick 1-2 sentence note? I’ll collect by Wed EOD.
Priya: People Ops here — we can allocate up to $125 from team events for food/gift. Please save receipts and cc people-ops@redwood on the expense.
Marco: I’ll handle a tiny playlist and bring napkins/plates.
Maya: Can we do a quick poll for food prefs? React with emoji: :cake: for cake + sandwiches, :taco: for tacos, :green_salad: for salad/vegan heavy.
Sophie: Nice — thank you!! Also, if anyone wants to contribute to a gift, DM Katie and she’ll coordinate amounts. No pressure.
Amir: RSVP: yes. Food: :taco: (also will bring gluten-free wraps option)
Jin: :green_salad: (vegan entrée incoming)
Liz: :cake: Thanks!
Katie: :cake: (card duty)
Priya: ✅ leaving it to you all — ping me if you need the budget code.
Marco: :taco:
Maya: :cake: Will post a reminder Wed morning. Everyone please DM Katie for gift contributions.
Sophie: You’re the best. Putting a calendar hold now: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=01sophie-surprise (please don’t share link outside Redwood)
Katie: Sign-up so far: Amir: wraps + fruit; Jin: vegan entrée; Liz: cake pickup; Marco: plates/napkins + playlist; Katie: card + photo book.
Liz: Quick q — are partners welcome? (thinking of bringing my partner to help with cake pickup)
Sophie: Partners are welcome to help, but we want it to stay a team thing — they can drop off but maybe skip the surprise part so we don't blow the cover 😅
Priya: Also, if you need help with remote folks who want to send a message, we can print a 'virtual messages' sheet.
Amir: Can we also do a tiny diaper raffle? (jokes) :joy:
Sophie: Hah maybe not a raffle, but fun idea. Thank you all ❤
Katie: Thanks! I’ll compile notes and attach the card Tues night.
Sophie: Appreciate you all — can’t wait. Please keep it hush-hush!
